implemented: Reuse the pinned 25-symbol LibSystemd ABI without a library loader or automatic connection.
One sender and nonce-bound unit; exact destination/path/interface/signature/argument selection, single-shot unit mutations and no reconnect.
Only known jobs may be queried, and cancellation additionally requires an independently read matching owner tuple.
Decode strict booleans, actual empty/nonzero InvocationID arrays and owner structs; selected property snapshots bracket InvocationID and read ControlGroup from Service.
Enforce an absolute opening ceiling, final deadline checks for named absence, sticky disconnect and one-shot close with separate returned-close fact.
Retain primary, resource-cleanup and raised errors separately across later requests; bound private failure history to 16 entries with count and explicit overflow.
